# 1652. Defuse the Bomb

## Solution 1 (time O(nk), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def decrypt(self, code, k):
        """
        :type code: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        n = len(code)
        ans = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        if k == 0:
            return ans
        if k > 0:
            t = 1
        else:
            t = -1
            k = -k
        for i in range(n):
            p = (i + t) % n
            for _ in range(k):
                ans[i] += code[p]
                p = (p + t) % n
        return ans
```
